The '''Orooturoo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orooturoo]], which was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Unidentified Orooturoo species|Nampi's species]].
